queries.result: First-party Malayalam search results identified Kerala Revenue/Survey land-record portals and the official Ente Bhoomi land-information system. Public pages describe parcel maps and survey services, but no safe anonymous Tanur parcel feature response was obtained.

officialSources.observation: Kerala Revenue Department describes eMaps as integrating cadastral maps with land records and states that citizens can obtain digital sketches of individual parcels.
Official Kerala Bhu-Naksha viewer landing page was identified, but direct TLS validation failed because the host certificate was expired; TLS verification was not disabled.
Official Kerala Ente Bhoomi portal identifies integrated Revenue, Registration, Survey and land-information services and real-time land parcel maps.
Official Malappuram district administration lists Tanur as a district block; this supports local administrative identity, not parcel coverage.

requests.outcome: Certificate expired. No certificate exception was used; viewer JavaScript/service inspection could not proceed on this host.
Official portal loaded. HTML exposed /web/ilms/map and a public map-library JavaScript route; page states that services depend on completed or ongoing digital survey villages.

Current JavaScript/configuration was inspected. It exposes POST /web/ilms/map/view and bounded parcel routes /web/proxy/mapinfo/extent/{locationCode}, /web/proxy/mapinfo/feature_info/{locationCode}, and /web/proxy/click_info/multiple/{locationCode}; no feature request was executed without a valid village/location code.
Current Ente Bhoomi Bhu-Naksha host returned an access-denied response. No login, token, CAPTCHA or bypass was attempted.
Official Malappuram taluk list returned JSON and included Tirur taluk.
Official Tirur-taluk village list returned JSON, but no Tanur/താനൂർ village entry was exposed in the checked published/all-village response. This is not evidence that Tanur lacks cadastral coverage.

registryBasis: Kerala Revenue Department and Survey/land-record portals are first-party state custodians; official Malappuram administration identifies Tanur locally. The evidence establishes a registry/map custodian but not an open Tanur parcel endpoint or citywide coverage.
crs: The current Ente Bhoomi map JavaScript declares EPSG:32643 for its map configuration; no parcel feature response was retrieved, so parcel geometry CRS remains unverified.
